summary: Qismah refers to a division or apportionment of things into shares. It can also mean a portion or share itself, similar to qism. The term implies something that has been divided or distributed.
lane: قِسْمَةٌ ذ is also used in the sense of مَقْسُومٌ [meaning A thing, or collection of things, divided into portions, or shares ]: (Bd and Jel in liv. 28:) a portion, or share; like قِسْمٌ : (Msb:) [and portions, or shares; as in the phrase,] نُخْرِجُ طَرِيقًا مِنْ بَيْنِ قِسْمَةِ الأَرْضِ أَوِ الدَّارِ [ We will exclude a way, or passage, from among the portions, or shares, of the land, or the house ]. (Mgh in art. رفع .)

headwords.def: and He divided; parted; divided in parts or shares; distributed. قَسَمَ أَمْرَهُ, or: see 3 in art. عدل.
قَاسَمَهُ الشَّىْءَ He divided with him the thing, each of them allotting to himself his share, or portion. قَاسَمَهُ بِٱللّٰهِ He swore to him by God.
أَقْسَمَ عَلَيْهِ He conjured him; he said بِحَقِّكَ. (Mgh, art. طمر.)
It (a thing) was, or became, divided, or distributed. (MA.) See an ex. in a verse, voce شَتَّانَ.
اِنْقَسَمَ الَى أَقْسَامٍ كَثِيرَةٍ It was divided into many parts.
He sought to know what was allotted to him, by means of the أَزْلَام, (S, * Mgh, and Har, p. 465,) and what was not allotted to him. (Mgh, Har.)

A division: (Msb:) and particularly (Msb) a portion, or share. (S, Msb, K.) Pl. أَقْسَامٌ. لَيْسَ مِنْ أَقْساَمِ كَ َا It is not a part of such a thing; it does not belong, or appertain, to such a thing; it is independent of such a thing.
A conjurement. See أَقْسَمَ عَلَيْهِ. An oath (S, Msb, K) by God [ &c. ]. (Msb, K.) An asseveration. وَاوُ القَسَمِ The و denoting an oath.

is also used in the sense of مَقْسُومٌ [meaning A thing, or collection of things, divided into portions, or shares ]: (Bd and Jel in liv. 28:) a portion, or share; like قِسْمٌ: (Msb:) [and portions, or shares; as in the phrase,] نُخْرِجُ طَرِيقًا مِنْ بَيْنِ قِسْمَةِ الأَرْضِ أَوِ الدَّارِ [ We will exclude a way, or passage, from among the portions, or shares, of the land, or the house ]. (Mgh in art. رفع.)
An officer of the Kádee, who divides inheritances.
